notes.title: HTCVive Version released + Summer Sale + Motion Controls info (updated)
notes.content:
The Early Access Vive version is out!   It also includes the Rift version, the Native Oculus SDK is best for Rift players. (for now).  If you already own iOmoon, then this update will give you a free Vive version :)

Primary Control: Gamepad 

Motion Controls: Basic
!! There is very basic motion controller support after landing on iO...working on adding more support but don't want to let you down with limited support.
Use the gamepad for menus and navigation.

- Right controller: flashlight and flare gun
- Left controller: flashlight

Do not use a HOTAS or other controller while playing, there is a Unity bug that can screw with controls causing a stuck rotation.  I'm looking into it for sure!

Hope you like it!    Make sure to grab it during the Summer sale!
-Drew

notes.title: iOMoon patch Update to v1.1 (1113063)
notes.content:
- Added Turn speed settings to KEYBOARD keys #'s 1-5 (five speeds)
- Added interior turn speed control levers (two speeds: 1 & 3)
- Default smooth turn is now set as FAST (#3)
- removed DPAD use for now
- Optimizations
